spans.s: प्रहणन n. Killing, slaughter.
प्रहत a. (f. ता) 1. Wounded, killed; 2. defeated, overcome; 3. beaten (as a drum), Megh.ii.1; 4. spread, expanded; 5. accomplished, learned; 6. beaten, frequented (as a path).
प्रहत a. (f. ता) 1. Wounded, killed; 2. defeated, overcome; 3. beaten (as a drum), Megh.ii.1; 4. spread, expanded; 5. accomplished, learned; 6. beaten, frequented (as a path).
प्रहर m. The eighth part of a whole day comprising nearly three hours, प्रहरविरतौ मध्ये बाहस्ततोऽपि परेऽथवा Am.

प्रहार m. 1. Striking, beating, Yaj.iii.248; 2. wounding, killing; 3. suiting, fitting; 4. a blow, a knock, a stroke (as in मुष्टिप्रहार), R.vii.44; 5. a cut, a thrust (as in खड्गप्रहार); 6. a kick (as in पादप्रहार).
प्रहरक m. A watch.
प्रहरण n. 1. Staking, beating; 2. assailing, attacking; 3. removing, expelling; 4. war, battle; 5. a weapon, Bg.i.9, R.xiii.73; 6. a covered car or litter.
प्रहारण n. A desirable gift.
प्रहरणीय n. A weapon.
प्रहरिन् m. 1. A watchman; 2. a bellman.
प्रहर्तृ a. (f. र्त्री) 1. Striking, beating; 2. fighting; 3. shooting.
प्रहर्तृ a. (f. र्त्री) 1. Striking, beating; 2. fighting; 3. shooting.
प्रहर्ष m. 1. Exultation, rapture, extreme joy, R.iii.17; 2. erection of the male organ.
प्रहर्षण (I) n. Making extremely glad.
प्रहर्षण (II) m. The planet Mercury.
प्रहर्ष(र्षि)णी f. 1. Turmeric; 2. name of a metre. (See App. I.)
प्रहर्ष(र्षि)णी f. 1. Turmeric; 2. name of a metre. (See App. I.)
प्रहर्षुल m. The planet Mercury.

प्रहसन n. 1. Violent laughter; 2. ridicule, irony, mockery; 3. satire, satirical writing; 4. a kind of comedy; (the S.D. defines it thus- भाणवत् संधिसंध्यगकस्यांगंकैर्विनिर्मितम् । भवेत् प्रहसनंवृत्तं निंद्यानां कविकल्पितम्), e.g. कंदर्पकेलि.
प्रहसंती f. 1. A kind of jasmine; 2. a large fire-pan.
प्रहसित n. Laughter, mirth.
प्रहस्त m. 1. The open hand with the fingers extended; 2. name of one of the generals of Rāvaṇa.
प्रहाण n. Abandoning, omitting.
प्रहाणि f. 1. Abandoning; 2. deficiency, want.
प्रहार-आर्त n. acute pain from a wound.
प्रहास m. 1. Violent laughter; 2. ridicule, derision; 3. irony; 4. a dancer, an actor; 5. an epithet of Śiva; 6. name of a place of pilgrimage.
प्रहासिन् m. A jester, a buffoon.
प्रहि m. A well.
प्रहित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Stretched out, extended; 2. sent, dispatched, विचारमार्गप्रहितेन चेतसा K.S.v.42; 3. appointed; 4. discharged (as an arrow); 5. suitable, appropriate.
प्रहित (II) n. Sauce, condiment.
प्रहित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Stretched out, extended; 2. sent, dispatched, विचारमार्गप्रहितेन चेतसा K.S.v.42; 3. appointed; 4. discharged (as an arrow); 5. suitable, appropriate.
प्रहीण (I) a. (f. णा) Abandoned, quitted.
प्रहीण (II) n. Destruction, loss, removal.
प्रहीण (I) a. (f. णा) Abandoned, quitted.
प्रहुत m.n. One of the five daily Yajnyas consisting in the offerings of food to all created beings (भूतयज्ञ). See M.iii.74.
प्रहृत (I) a. (f. ता) Struck, beaten, wounded.
प्रहृत (II) n. A stroke, a blow.
प्रहृत (I) a. (f. ता) Struck, beaten, wounded.
प्रहृष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Rejoiced, pleased, overjoyed; 2. bristling.
प्रहृष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Rejoiced, pleased, overjoyed; 2. bristling.
प्रहृष्ट-आत्मन्, -मनस् a. rejoiced in mind, delighted at heart.
प्रहृष्ट-आत्मन्, -मनस् a. rejoiced in mind, delighted at heart.
प्रहृष्टक m. A crow.
प्रहेणक n. A kind of cake.
प्रहेलक n. 1. A riddle, an enigma, a puzzling question; 2. a kind of cake.
प्रहेला f. Playful dalliance, loose behaviour.

प्रहेलि f. A poetic riddle, thus defined by Dharmadāsa- व्यक्तीकृत्य कमप्यर्थं स्वरूपार्थस्य गोपनात् । यत्र बाह्यांतरावर्थौ कथ्येते सा प्रहेलिका. [The following is an instance- तरुण्यालिंगितः कंठे नितंबस्थलमाश्रितः । गुरूणां संनिधानेऽपि कः कूजति मुहुर्मुहुः, the intended answer being ईषदूनजलपूर्णकुंभ.] Danḍin mentions sixteen kinds of Prahelikā. See K.D.iii.96-124.

प्रह्रा(ह्ला)द m. 1. Joy, pleasure, happiness; 2. noise, sound; 3. name of a son of Hiraṇyakaśipu. (See App. II.)
प्रह्रा(ह्ला)द m. 1. Joy, pleasure, happiness; 2. noise, sound; 3. name of a son of Hiraṇyakaśipu. (See App. II.)
प्रह्रा(ह्ला)दन (I) a. (f. ना) Causing joy, gladdening, R.xiii.4.
प्रह्रा(ह्ला)दन (II) n. The act of causing joy, gladdening, यथा प्रह्लादनाच्चंद्रः R.iv.12.

प्रह्लन्न a. (f. न्ना) Pleased, joyful.
प्रह्लन्न a. (f. न्ना) Pleased, joyful.
प्रह्व a. (f. ह्वा) 1. Sloping, slanting, inclining; 2. bowing humbly, stooping, भक्तिप्रह्वविलोकनप्रणयिनी (नेत्रे तनुर्वा हरेः) K.Pr.ix.; 3. devoted to, engaged in; 4. submissive, humble, R.xvi.80.

प्रह्व-अंजलि a. putting to the forehead the palms of the hands in token of respect.
प्रह्वलीका f. The same as प्रहेलिका q.v.
प्रह्वाय m. Summoning, invocation.
प्राह m. Instruction in the art of dancing.
प्राह्ण m. The forenoon.
प्राह्णेतमाम् ind. very early in the morning.
प्राह्णेतमाम् ind. very early in the morning.
प्राह्णेतन a. happening in the forenoon.
